from JIRA [DS-2904] created by bollini

If the server is not able to reach the google analytics server retrieving bitstreams to show thumbnails or get the actual fulltext hold the database connection for several minutes and retry exhausting the database pool very fastly.

The only available workaround is to disable the google analytics listner in the applicationContext.xml

As the current implementation doesn't use the http proxy configured to reach the external network this problem is very easy to affect any installation in a private network
